'''Upulu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Upulu was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Master Upulu selected the young [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Shalimin]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="OTF" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Master Upulu took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. While Master Upulu was away fighting, Padawan Shalimin was selected to serve beside [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] during the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Dac]] where the two led the Republic to victory over the Confederacy. As the report came to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], Fisto detailed how Shalimin had reveled in the victory in a way unbecoming of a Jedi. Shamed by his Padawan's actions Upulu sent Shalimin to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]] to assist in the defensive there. While an initial failure, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived with reinforcements which ensured a Republic victory.<ref name="OTF" />
